metadata.real_data: Names, source IDs and selected source assertions from frozen Wikidata/MusicBrainz records. Source assertions are not universal factual certification.
limitations: No production queries or graph writes were performed.
Partial coverage only; these counts are for this selected fixture.
Role and publisher qualifiers are kept in relation_records, not inferred from flat arrays.
No recursive scheduler implementation is claimed by this data fixture.

The three game nodes are internal, visibility=false and game_publication_status=pending: artwork ingestion and public publication have not completed. Counts include internal graph records; incident game edges are not public.
